Two ways to guard a crossing
Hardware decides which way data can go. Rules and inspection decide what may go.
Three layers. Bottom: hardware decides the direction. Middle: rules decide what may pass. Top: inspection looks inside the file. Say it aloud: no matching rule, no transfer.
Source: notes, Gateway and FlowRule. Evidence item 8 for the engine list.
Three isometric slabs stacking up, bottom slab labelled physics. A packet falls on the top slab, passes through, and stops at the bottom one in the wrong direction. Gold on the direction cue only.
PECCSM: Isn't this a firewall with extra steps? -> A firewall filters traffic that can travel both ways. Here the return path does not exist in hardware; inspection sits on top.
